summary: Frontend testing of Optowire Angular 21 SSR mega-menu feature. All 8 required features pass. Mega-menu opens on hover, shows 6 categories with icons/subcategories, navigates correctly, closes properly. All other nav links functional.
critical_code_review_comments: NOTE: Playwright automation without force=True can trigger spurious mouseleave/mouseenter events on the mega-menu wrapper that cause navigation to resolve to homepage. With force=True (direct click dispatch), all navigation works correctly. This is a Playwright testing artifact, NOT a real user-facing issue — real users hover naturally and the 60ms/120ms timer guards handle the transition correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Angular 21 SSR app at catalog-preview-13.preview.emergentagent.com. Mega-menu feature fully working. data-testid attributes: nav-products-btn, nav-products-wrapper, mega-menu, mega-cat-[slug], mega-sub-[id], mega-view-all. Categories: telecommunication, network-equipment, security-systems, electronic-devices, iot, tools. telecom/network/security/iot have custom SVG icons; electronic-devices/tools use fallback grid SVG. Chevron on Products button rotates 180° when menu opens. Bottom bar shows '6 categories · 36 subcategories'. '+N more' links present for 4 categories (telecom +2, network +5, electronic-devices +1, iot +4). Previous iterations fixed: attribute filter chip labels (iter 6), combineLatest race condition (iter 5).
